crossing.method: zebra-stripe detector on the depth-registered ground plane

vehicle.label: SUV
vehicle.reason: No parked vehicle detected in the curb lane; 20 ft default.

person.label: child
person.reason: Curb end of the crossing near edge.

limitations: One frame; no independent reference. The hand test annotation is not ground truth.
Crossing is the near edge of the crosswalk in the curb lane. Measured depth near it clusters about 1 m apart; the nearer cluster is used, so it is uncertain by about 0.5 m along the road.
The near-edge angle is not measured reliably and is not used; the road axis follows the curb.
The curb face is the half-height point of a measured transition about 0.3 m wide; the declared 0.15 m curb gap is measured from it.
No parked vehicle is measured here: the vehicle is a declared what-if with default SUV size.
The person position and 1.1 m height are declared defaults, not detections.
Geometric visibility only; not parking safety, recognition or compliance.
